```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(broom)


```

Loading file
```{r}
gene_exp <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/gene_exp.RData")
pt_status <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_status.RData")

```
Splitting by cohort and outcome
```{r}
tc.tox.outcomes <- filter(pt_status, Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Toxicity")
tc.tox.data <- filter(gene_exp, (Sample %in% tc.tox.outcomes$Sample))
```

```{r}
#renaming column and merging 
tc.tox.df <- left_join(tc.tox.outcomes, tc.tox.data, by = c("Sample" = "Sample" ))
#adding numbers for outcome
tc.tox.df <- tc.tox.df %>% mutate(Outcome = case_when(
  Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ 0))


# Get a vector of gene names
genes <- colnames(tc.tox.df[, 4:82])
fixed.genes <- make.names(colnames(tc.tox.df[, 4:82]))

#renaming columns to ones that don't produce an error
fixed.tc.tox.df <- tc.tox.df %>% 
  rename_with(~ fixed.genes[which((genes) == .x)], .cols = any_of(genes))

#create data frame to store the output 
logr_tox_noipi <- (data.frame(gene = genes,
                   estimate = NA,
                   p.value = NA))


geneoutcome <- fixed.tc.tox.df %>%
  select(-Sample, -Reason.for.discontinuation) 



for (g in 1:length(fixed.genes)) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("Outcome ~ ",fixed.genes[g]))
   tmp <- glm(formula = f, data = geneoutcome, family = binomial)
   tmpdf <- broom::tidy(tmp)
#  retrieve the line of interest with g, estimate, and p-value
   logr_tox_noipi$estimate[g] <- tmpdf$estimate[2]
   logr_tox_noipi$p.value[g] <- tmpdf$p.value[2]
 
}
write.csv(logr_tox_noipi, "../Outputs/logr_adj_tox.csv", row.names = FALSE)
save(logr_tox_noipi, file = "logr_tox_noipi.Rdata")

logr_tox_noipi <- logr_tox_noipi %>%
   mutate(neg.log = -log10(p.value)) 


labeled_data <- logr_tox_noipi %>%
  filter(gene == "TNFRSF18" |
           gene == "VTCN1" |
           gene == "CCR4" |
           gene == "AHR" |
           gene == "TIGIT")

boruta_data <- logr_tox_noipi %>%
  filter(gene == "TNF" |
           gene == "PDCD1LG2")


logr_tox_noipi <- logr_tox_noipi %>% anti_join(labeled_data)
logr_tox_noipi <- logr_tox_noipi %>% anti_join(boruta_data)


```

#Fig 3C plot
```{r}
logr_tox_noipi_graph <- ggplot(data = logr_tox_noipi, aes(x = estimate, y = neg.log)) +
            geom_point(color = "grey42", size = 4) +
  geom_point(
    data = labeled_data,
    color = "black",
    shape = 2, 
    size = 4, 
    stroke = 2) +
  geom_point(
    data = boruta_data,
    color = "black",
    shape = 0, 
    size = 4, 
    stroke = 2) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  xlab(NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),  
  ) 


print(logr_tox_noipi_graph)
ggsave("../figures/ToxAdjVol.png", height = 6, width = 11)

```
